annotations.betterLine: Cast Pyrogoyf for {3}{R} using City of Traitors + Mountain, dealing approximately 5 damage to the opponent on ETB (bringing them to ~6 life) while deploying a large threat. Could potentially even cast two threats this turn with the remaining mana.

Broadside Bombardiers is a 2/2 that's relatively low-impact.

annotations.betterLine: Exile Simian Spirit Guide for {R}, then cast The One Ring for {4}. The protection from everything shields against Sneak Attack threats, and the card draw engine helps find more threats to close the game.

annotations.betterLine: Exile Simian Spirit Guide for {R}, tap 3 Mountains to cast The One Ring. This provides protection from everything until next turn (critical defense against Sneak Attack) and sets up a powerful card draw engine for subsequent turns.
